etsy.title: Git Art Print, working tree clean Poster, Version Control Humor, Software Developer Office Decor
etsy.description:
A git art print for the rare, satisfying moment git status says working tree clean, in dark-mode colors.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a home office, dev den, or coding setup.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Funny git prints on Etsy center on commit messages ('I have no idea what I'm doing', 'in case of fire: git commit, git push'); a clean-tree celebration did not appear.
Many git listings are command cheat sheets sold as digital downloads.
Developer wall decor listings pair a code line with a short witty caption, the same format as this poster.
No git-specific posters surfaced on Amazon; git shows up only inside developer-skills T-shirts.
Amazon titles add room and use words: 'office', 'home workspaces', 'unframed'.

research.notes: Listing pages were not fetched (network allow-list); evidence is from Etsy/Amazon search results only. 'git art' (an Etsy market phrase) leads instead of 'git poster' so this listing does not compete head-on with the project's other git posters; 'git poster' is kept as a tag. GitHub is not printed, so it is kept out. No priceRange: no comparable physical prices seen.
